techTerms.componentes: Reusable interface blocks that encapsulate HTML, logic and styles
techTerms.useState: React hook that creates reactive variables that automatically update the UI
techTerms.localStorage: Browser API that persists data to disk between sessions
techTerms.API: Interface that enables communication between services (request/response)
techTerms.LLMs: Large Language Models - AI models trained on millions of code examples
techTerms.prompt: Natural language instruction you give the AI to generate code
techTerms.React: JavaScript library for building user interfaces with components
techTerms.Tailwind CSS: Utility-first CSS framework with predefined classes
techTerms.v0.dev: AI tool to generate React components from prompts
techTerms.Next.js: React framework with integrated routing and API routes
techTerms.system prompt: Permanent instructions that define LLM behavior
techTerms.API route: Endpoint in Next.js that executes server-side code
techTerms.asíncronas: Operations that don't block code execution (await/async)
techTerms.PrivyProvider: React component that provides authentication to the entire app
techTerms.endpoint: Specific API URL that executes a function
techTerms.POST: HTTP method to send data to server
techTerms.GET: HTTP method to retrieve data from server
techTerms.toast notifications: Non-intrusive popup messages that inform the user
techTerms.Multimodal: AI that processes multiple data types (text + images)
techTerms.base64: Format that converts binary files (images) to text
techTerms.HTML5 File API: Native browser API for handling files
techTerms.Drag-and-drop: UX pattern for uploading files by dragging
techTerms.Polling: Periodically querying API to update data
techTerms.WebSockets: Permanent connection to receive real-time updates
techTerms.Paginación: Load data in chunks to improve performance
techTerms.Grid: Grid-based layout to display multiple items

promptsSection.title: 💬 Prompts for v0
promptsSection.description: Copy these prompts and paste them into v0 to generate the code for each session:
promptsSection.session1Prompt:
Create a React component called RegenmonDisplay that shows:

1. A Tamagotchi-style container with rounded borders and gradient background
2. A centered pet image (use a placeholder for now)
3. Three progress bars below:
   - Happiness (green color)
   - Energy (blue color)
   - Level (purple color)
4. Each bar should show the percentage with a number
5. An orange button "Create Regenmon" that opens a modal
6. The modal should have:
   - Input for name
   - Selector for type (Fire, Water, Earth)
   - Confirm button

Use Tailwind CSS with modern glassmorphism style. Bars should be animated.
promptsSection.session2Prompt:
Create a ChatInterface component that:

1. Has a scrollable message area
2. Shows chat bubbles:
   - User messages aligned right (orange background)
   - Regenmon messages aligned left (gray background)
3. Input at the bottom with:
   - Text field to write
   - Send button with icon
   - Loading spinner when processing
4. Shows "Writing..." when AI is responding
5. Uses useState to handle messages
6. Includes a button to clear chat

Style: Modern with glassmorphism, smooth animations when messages appear.
promptsSection.session3Prompt:
Create a simple LoginScreen component:

1. Centered welcome screen
2. Game logo or title at top
3. Large "Enter" button that simulates login
4. After login, shows username at top
5. Small "Logout" button in top right corner
6. Uses localStorage to remember if user logged in

Style: Minimalist and clean, uses orange and gray colors.
promptsSection.session4Prompt:
Create an EvolutionSystem component:

1. Shows current Regenmon stage:
   - Baby (level 1-5)
   - Young (level 6-10)
   - Adult (level 11+)
2. Progress bar to next evolution
3. Daily missions section:
   - List of 3 missions
   - Checkbox to complete
   - Token reward
4. "Upload Photo" button that opens:
   - Drop area to drag image
   - Image preview
   - "Evaluate" button that simulates AI
5. Shows earned tokens with animation

Style: Cards with glassmorphism, modern icons.
promptsSection.session5Prompt:
Create a SocialHub component:

1. User pets gallery:
   - Grid of cards with photo, name and level
   - Clicking shows details
2. Rankings table:
   - Top 10 users by tokens
   - Avatar, name, tokens, position
3. Button to interact with another pet
4. Marketplace section:
   - Grid of items (food, accessories)
   - Price in tokens
   - Buy button

Style: Professional, use tabs to separate sections, smooth animations.

layersPage.title: The 5 Layers
layersPage.subtitle: Every functional application is built on these 5 fundamental layers. You change the content, not the structure.

keyInsight.title: Key Insight
keyInsight.description: All the apps you use every day have the same 5 layers. You change the content, not the structure.

layer1.name: UI (Interface)
layer1.subtitle: What you see on screen
layer1.description: Everything visual in your app: colors, buttons, text, images. It's what your users see and touch.
layer1.simple: Everything you see and touch on the screen

layer2.name: DATA (Data)
layer2.subtitle: Your app's memory
layer2.description: This is where all information is stored: names, messages, progress. It's like your app's memory.
layer2.simple: Everything your app remembers when you close and reopen it

layer3.name: AI (Intelligence)
layer3.subtitle: Your app's brain
layer3.description: The artificial intelligence that makes your app understand, think and respond as if it were intelligent.
layer3.simple: Everything that makes your app seem intelligent and respond like a person
inRegenmon: When your pet talks to you
When it evaluates photos you upload
The responses it gives based on its mood

layer4.name: AUTH (Login)
layer4.subtitle: Your identity in the app
layer4.description: The system that lets you log into your account and keeps your information separate from other users.
includes: What you can and can't do
layer4.simple: How the app knows it's you and lets you see only your stuff

layer5.name: DEPLOY (Publishing)
layer5.subtitle: Share your app with the world
layer5.description: The process of taking your app from your computer to the internet so anyone can use it. It's like publishing a video on YouTube, but with your application.
includes: Upload your app to the internet
Make it work from any device
layer5.simple: From your computer to the internet for everyone to see it
inRegenmon: Your app runs 24/7 even when you close your computer
You can share a link with your friends
Works from any phone or computer
Every time you improve something, it updates automatically

userFlow.title: How They Work Together
userFlow.description: Typical application flow from when the user opens the URL until they see changes reflected.

bootcampProgress.title: Bootcamp Progression
bootcampProgress.description: How you'll build your app layer by layer throughout the 5 sessions.

transferability.title: Transferability
transferability.description: All the apps you use every day have the same 5 layers. You change the content, not the structure. This knowledge transfers to any application you build.

debugging.title: Debugging Clarity
debugging.description: Visual problem → Layer 1 | Data not saving → Layer 2 | AI responding incorrectly → Layer 3 | Login issues → Layer 4 | App not loading → Layer 5

modularity.title: Modularity
modularity.description: You can change one layer without touching the others. Changing databases doesn't affect the UI. Changing UI frameworks doesn't affect data logic.
